title: Welcome to Python: Your First Program
objectives: Explain what a programming language is
Write and run a Python script

content.title: What is Programming?
content.explanation: A program is a set of instructions that tells a computer what to do. Python is a high-level programming language that reads like English. When you run a Python program, the Python interpreter reads your code line by line and executes each instruction.
key_points: Code is written in plain text files with .py extension
The Python interpreter executes instructions sequentially
Programming is about solving problems by breaking them into steps

content.title: Your First Program
content.explanation: The print() function displays text to the screen. Text must be in quotes (single or double). Each statement goes on its own line.

content.title: Running a Python Program
content.explanation: The python command starts the interpreter, which reads and executes your file.

content.title: Predict the Output
content.question: What will this program display?
content.explanation: Each print() call outputs on a new line by default.

content.title: Fix the Syntax Error
content.task: Find and fix the syntax error
content.hint: Count the quotation marks on line 1

questions.question: What file extension do Python files use?
What does the Python interpreter do?
options: Reads and executes code line by line
questions.correct_answer: Reads and executes code line by line

content.title: Key Takeaways
points: Python programs are text files with .py extension
print() displays output to the screen
Strings must be enclosed in matching quotes
Syntax errors prevent the program from running

exercises.title: Hello World Variations
exercises.description: Write a program that prints your name, favorite color, and a fun fact about yourself, each on a separate line.
hints: Each print() automatically adds a newline

exercises.title: Print with Special Characters
exercises.description: Print a message that includes quotation marks and a backslash.
hints: Use single quotes outside to include double quotes inside

quiz.question: What is the correct way to print Hello World in Python?
quiz.explanation: Python uses print() function with parentheses and quotes for strings.

quiz.question: What happens if you forget a closing quote on a string?
options: The program runs but prints nothing
quiz.explanation: Python requires matching opening and closing quotes for strings.

quiz.question: How do you run a Python file named hello.py from the command line?
quiz.explanation: The python command starts the interpreter to run your file.
